_comment: Grok harness hook wiring, installed by the Grokbit VS Code extension (Grokbit: Install workspace harness hooks, or grok.hooks.provision: workspace). Auto-discovered from .grok/hooks/*.json once this project is trusted -- run /hooks-trust, or the hooks never fire. Commands need a Python interpreter on PATH; the extension probes for python/python3 at install time and rewrites the interpreter below to whichever it found. Command paths are relative to the workspace root -- confirmed by live probe (see README.md) to be the hook process's own cwd on this CLI; ${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT} / $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR expansion in command strings was tested and did NOT fire, despite being documented. To uninstall, delete .grok/hooks/. Lineage: GrokForge agentic-team template, ADR 0001.
